data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'farahah' meaning 'joy'. It is a name given to a girl who is believed to bring happiness and joy to her family and community. The name Farhatah carries the meaning “Bringer of joy” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Farhatah usually hope their child will grow to embody bringer of joy and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name 'Farhatah' is a testament to the belief that a child can bring great joy and happiness to her family and community. This joy can manifest in many ways, such as a cheerful disposition, a warm personality, or a talent for spreading laughter and positivity.

It is a reminder of the importance of cultivating positive emotions and spreading love and kindness. In Islamic tradition, this is embodied in the Prophet Muhammad's hadith, "The believer's shade on the day of Resurrection will be his goodness" - meaning that the good deeds and kind actions that one does in this world will bring them joy and blessings in the Hereafter. By giving a child the name 'Farhatah', parents may be instilling in them a sense of responsibility and duty to spread joy and happiness, not just to themselves and their loved ones, but to all of creation.
